We offer a PhD position in the research group of Dr. Frederik Kotz-Helmer, which is embedded within the NeptunLab led by Prof. Bastian E. Rapp at the Department of Microsystems Engineering (IMTEK), University of Freiburg. NeptunLab is a highly interdisciplinary research environment focusing on the development of novel materials, manufacturing technologies, and processes for industrial applications. Research from the NeptunLab has been published in leading international journals, including Lab on a Chip, Advanced Materials, Angewandte Chemie, and Nature, and has received attention from national and international media outlets such as the BBC, The New York Times, and the Discovery Channel.
Glass is an essential engineering material for applications ranging from optics and photonics to microtechnology and high-performance components. However, conventional glass manufacturing technologies strongly limit the geometries that can be produced and often require complex and energy-intensive processing routes.
Within this PhD project, a novel extrusion-based manufacturing technology for glass will be developed. The approach is based on highly filled thermoplastic nanocomposites containing silica nanoparticles dispersed in a polymeric binder system. These materials are shaped in the polymeric state by extrusion and subsequently converted into dense, transparent glass through debinding and sintering.
A major focus of the project will be the development of thermoplastic nanocomposites with tailored rheological and mechanical properties. Polymer composition, molecular weight, particle loading, particle dispersion, and processing conditions will be systematically investigated to establish relationships between material formulation, flow behavior, extrusion stability, and the geometry of the resulting components. Structured extrusion dies will be used to directly manufacture complex cross-sectional geometries, providing a new route toward continuous manufacturing of structured glass components.
The successful candidate will work at the interface of materials science, polymer processing, rheology, nanocomposites, and glass technology. The project combines fundamental materials research with the development of a new manufacturing process and therefore provides substantial freedom for both scientific investigation and technology development.
Developing highly filled thermoplastic silica nanocomposites for extrusion-based glass manufacturing.
Designing polymer binder systems with tailored rheological, mechanical, and debinding properties.
Developing and optimizing extrusion processes for complex and microstructured geometries.
Investigating the relationship between extrusion parameters, die geometry, material flow, and dimensional accuracy.
Designing and evaluating structured extrusion dies for the continuous manufacturing of complex glass components.
Characterizing nanocomposites and glasses using techniques such as SEM, XRD, FTIR, Raman spectroscopy, rheology, thermal analysis, and optical characterization.
Establishing quantitative material-process-structure relationships for extrusion-based glass manufacturing.
Presenting research results at international conferences and publishing findings in peer-reviewed journals.

Master’s degree/Bachelor’s degree/Studies in Material Science, Mechanical Engineering, Process Engineering or related subjects
Profound knowledge of polymer chemistry, material science and processing is required
Knowledge of glass science, ceramic processing or polymer extrusion are/is beneficial.

You should be able to structure and document your work properly
You should be a creative mind without causing excessive chaos around you

jobs.occupation: Sales Manager (f/m/d) Test & Validation - DACH (Ingenieur/in - Gebäudetechnik)
jobs.description:
Shape the Future of Engineering Test & Validation

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation - helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Our Testing business sits at the heart of this transformation. As products become more software-defined, connected, electrified, and complex, manufacturers need to bring together physical testing, data acquisition, simulation, analysis, and engineering software into a connected validation process.
This creates a significant growth opportunity - and we are looking for an exceptional commercial leader to lead it across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland (DACH).

The Opportunity
As Test Country Lead (w/m/d) DACH, you will own the commercial success and growth of the Siemens Test business across the region.
You will lead the Sales and PreSales organization while remaining highly visible in the market and directly engaged with strategic customers. This is a player-coach leadership role: you will build and develop a high-performing organization while personally shaping major opportunities, executive relationships, and strategic accounts.
You will spend at least 50% of your time with strategic customers and in the market, ensuring that you remain close to customer priorities, technology trends, competitive dynamics, and the opportunities shaping the future of engineering test and validation.
This is an opportunity to build and grow a significant business in one of the world's most important engineering markets, supported by Siemens' global technology portfolio, resources, and customer relationships.
What you will ownLead the DACH Test Business

- Own the overall commercial performance of the Test business across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.- Drive revenue, growth, profitability, and market-share objectives across hardware, software, maintenance, and customer & engineering services.- Define and execute the regional business strategy and annual operating plan.- Identify new growth opportunities, markets, customers, and routes to market.- Establish clear commercial priorities, KPIs, and accountability across the organization.

Lead from the Market- Personally engage with strategic customers and executive stakeholders, building trusted relationships at C-level and senior engineering levels.- Lead major strategic sales pursuits and complex, multi-year opportunities.- Develop compelling value propositions and quantified business cases that connect technology investment to measurable customer outcomes.- Understand customer engineering and validation challenges and translate them into differentiated Siemens solutions.- Maintain a strong understanding of market trends, competitor strategies, technology shifts, and emerging customer requirements.- Represent Siemens Test at customer events, industry conferences, and executive forums.

Build a High-Performing Sales Organization- Lead, coach, and develop the DACH Sales and PreSales organization.- Recruit and retain exceptional commercial and technical sales talent.- Create a culture of accountability, customer obsession, collaboration, and continuous improvement.- Align individual strengths and expertise with strategic market opportunities.- Establish clear development and succession plans for key roles.- Raise the overall standard of consultative, value-based, and solution-oriented selling.

Win in a Competitive Market- Develop differentiated strategies for strategic accounts and competitive opportunities.- Build strong account and territory plans that increase market penetration and customer value.- Lead competitive positioning across the Test & Validation landscape.- Govern Proof-of-Concept engagements with clear success criteria, commercial objectives, and transition plans.- Develop and manage a high-performing partner ecosystem to extend market reach and accelerate growth.

Connect Customers with Siemens Technology

- Work closely with global Product Management, Industry, Engineering, and Services teams to bring the right solutions to customers.- Ensure that customer feedback and market intelligence directly influence regional and global strategy.- Drive adoption of the broader Siemens portfolio by connecting test, measurement, simulation, engineering software, and services into compelling customer solutions.- Ensure operational excellence through accurate forecasting, disciplined opportunity management, reliable demonstrations, and measurable sales performance.

What You Bring

We are looking for an accomplished Sales Director, Business Leader, or Commercial Leader who combines strong sales leadership with a deep understanding of engineering-driven technology markets, especially in test & validation.

- A successful track record in B2B sales leadership within engineering software, test & measurement, validation, simulation, industrial technology, or a closely related field- Experience leading Sales and PreSales organizations with direct responsibility for regional business performance.- A proven record of winning complex, high-value opportunities involving multiple technical, commercial, and executive stakeholders.- Strong experience developing strategic accounts and building long-term relationships with senior engineering and executive decision-makers.- Experience selling solutions such as test & measurement, data acquisition, test automation, validation, simulation, NVH, HIL/XIL, engineering software, or related technologies is highly valuable.- Strong commercial judgment and demonstrated success in negotiations and complex deal structures.- The ability to translate sophisticated technology into clear customer value and compelling business outcomes.- Experience building, coaching, and motivating high-performing sales organizations.- A strong external network and understanding of the DACH engineering and manufacturing ecosystem.- Experience working with strategic partners and developing indirect routes to market.- Strong understanding of industries such as Automotive & Transportation, Aerospace & Defense, Electronics & Semiconductors, Energy, and Industrial Machinery.- Excellent executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and storytelling skills.- Willingness to travel regularly across the DACH region and internationally.- Highly proficient spoken and written German and English.

Why Us

We are Siemens: At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across many countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Equal Opportunities

jobs.occupation: Data & AI Engineer (all genders), PharmaHera Service GmbH (Data-Warehouse-Analyst/in)
jobs.description: Deine neue Umgebung: Behind PharmaHera is Atida - one of Europe's leading online pharmacy groups, serving over 5 million customers across 9 countries. Together with the CEPD Group, we combine more than 25 years of pharmaceutical expertise with digital excellence to redefine the online pharmacy experience: We are building a trusted, personalized health ecosystem that guides people from prevention to cure - backed by medical expertise and driven by our conviction: Pharmacy is about people. Based in Berlin, we serve as the group's competence center for Germany and the Netherlands. As a specialized partner, we manage e-commerce, marketing, IT, and logistics for our local mail-order pharmacies, such as APONEO. Our European markets run on a single, standardized data platform (our Foundation layer). Your mission for the future: To transform this data infrastructure so it is not only usable by people, but specifically prepared for AI agents that read, analyze, and autonomously act on it. The role Reporting to the Data & AI Engineer Lead, you will own the data pipelines, datasets, AI agents and tools built on top of Foundation, and you will build most of them with AI agents as part of your toolchain. The role sits one level of abstraction above the code: you specify, review and take responsibility for systems rather than typing every line. Core responsibilities Pipeline development: build and optimize data flows in Apache Airflow, from our European markets into BigQuery. Modeling in BigQuery: implement tables and views in the Foundation layer, guaranteeing KPI comparability across Spain, France, Italy and Germany. Semantic layer and data contracts: keep business definitions consistent across dashboards, models and agents, and define the schema, granularity and quality a dataset guarantees. AI-assisted delivery: use Claude Code and the Anthropic API as your everyday engineering environment -- turn a requirement into a precise specification, let the agent produce the pipeline, then review, test and own the result. Building for agents: expose Foundation through MCP tools and skills so that AIDA and our decision agents can query it reliably. A dataset is finished when an agent can use it without being misled. Evaluation: build the evals, checks and monitoring that tell us whether an agent's output is correct. Unit tests are not enough for non-deterministic systems. Data products: design data products for management, finance, commercial, operations and marketing -- reusable across markets. Visualization and reporting: work with the business team on reports and consumable datasets in Apache Superset. Code and traceability: clean Python and SQL, with every task traceable through our GitLab-Coda integration. Agent-generated code included. Your Profile & Tech Stack What You Bring to the Role (Must-Haves): Education & Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering or Data Science. AI-Assisted Engineering: Regular, demonstrable use of an LLM coding agent (Claude Code or equivalent) in daily work, plus the technical judgment to critically review agent-generated code. Tech Stack & Cloud: Solid experience with Google Cloud Platform (especially BigQuery), Apache Airflow, strong SQL, data-oriented Python, and version control via Git/GitLab. Languages: Fluent English for daily collaboration within our international team. Mindset & Work Ethic: Strong analytical skills, an independent and results-focused approach ("you get the problem and context, the solution design is yours to propose"), and a commitment to deeply understanding code rather than using AI as a blind shortcut. What Rounds Off Your Profile (Nice-to-Haves): Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), LLM APIs, ClearML, Docker, or Apache Druid. Know-how in evaluating non-deterministic systems and using BI tools (ideally Apache Superset). Industry experience in the healthcare, pharmacy, or e-commerce sectors, plus basic knowledge of German. What we are not looking for Someone who ships code they cannot explain. Someone who needs a ticket with the solution already inside it or with full requirements in place. We act fast: you get the problem, the context and access -- the design is yours to propose. Someone who uses AI as a shortcut and doesn't understand the problem they are solving. Someone who only thinks short-term. We build future-proof solutions. What You'll Get Your Work Environment: Freedom to Shape Your Role from Day 1: A position of responsibility with real opportunities for growth, where you can proactively drive initiatives and actively help shape strategies. Permanent, Full-Time Position: Long-term prospects in a future-proof market. Agile Work Environment: A motivated, dynamic team and flat hierarchies with short decision-making paths that enable fast execution. Flexibility with Team Spirit: Flexible working hours and a hybrid work model (mobile work & in-office) - with a focus on our Berlin office to foster collaboration and team cohesion. Direct Mentoring: Close collaboration and mentoring by the Data & AI Engineer Lead in a technically demanding environment. Hands-on Production Tech Stack: Real-world experience with Airflow, BigQuery, Druid, GCP, and a modern production AI stack (Claude, MCP, Agents, Evals). Professional AI Tooling: First-class AI engineering tools come as standard equipment. Your Benefits at a Glance: Health & Mobility: Urban Sports Club membership at an unbeatable price and a heavily discounted BVG corporate transit pass for your daily commute. Exclusive Perks: Attractive employee discounts on our entire APONEO product range, access to a wide variety of corporate benefits, and a Selgros card. All-Round Care: An on-campus cafeteria, free fresh fruit, vegetables, and snacks every day, plus an unlimited coffee and tea flat rate. Your Compensation & Terms: For this full-time, permanent position, we offer an attractive, market-based, and competitive compensation package. We anticipate an annual gross salary between EUR45,000 and EUR55,000 p.a. Together, we will determine your exact positioning within this range through a transparent process based on the following criteria: Your relevant practical work experience in Data & AI Engineering. Your professional qualifications and specific additional skills. Our internal salary structure to ensure fairness within the team. Equal Opportunity & Fair Pay: We don't leave fair pay to chance. We compensate all team members in equivalent positions transparently and fairly, regardless of gender or any other personal characteristic. Ready to join? Ready to actively shape the future of e-commerce and data-driven healthcare at Atida? Apply now! We look forward to receiving your CV and your earliest possible starting date.

Responsibilities

- Requirements and test management: Reviewing requirements and developing corresponding test cases.
- Planning, designing, documenting and implementing software and system tests.
- Coordinating and carrying out system and integration tests.
- Developing and maintaining test environments and the associated test infrastructure.
- Contributing to the development of new functions and creating the associated test models.
- Automating tests, including the development of automated test scripts and tools.
- Evaluation and selection of suitable tools and technologies for testing Safety PLCs.
- Supporting the continuous improvement of test strategies, test methods and processes.
- Ensuring and implementing quality requirements in accordance with internal and external standards.
- Ensuring the traceability of requirements through to test cases and test results.
- Reviewing and evaluating test results, including reporting and documentation.
- Carrying out qualitative fault analyses and assisting with root-cause analyses.
- Working closely with the development teams to seamlessly integrate testing into the development process.

Requirements

- A degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a comparable qualification.
- In-depth experience in software design, testing methods and programming skills, ideally in Python and/or Robot Framework.
- Knowledge of relevant functional safety standards (e.g. IEC 61508) and security standards (e.g. IEC 62443-4-X).
- Experience in working with safety PLCs and knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as Profinet, Ethernet/IP, Modbus, etc.
- A strong focus on quality and a systematic, analytical approach.
- Experience in working with test management tools and version control systems (e.g. Polarion, SVN, Git, or similar tools).
- Knowledge of test automation, including the development of test scripts for Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) environments.
- Experience in carrying out system and integration tests, ideally in the field of safety or embedded systems.
- Understanding of hardware-level testing and interfaces between software and hardware.
- Ability to work in interdisciplinary teams and to communicate technical content clearly and precisely.
- A structured and independent approach to work, with a focus on meeting deadlines and achieving objectives.
- Good written and spoken German and English.

The role

This is a Mid-Level strategic procurement role and you'll own a portfolio of indirect categories (Facilities Management [FM], MRO and  Utilities, MRO) across HelloFresh's European production sites, designing and executing category strategies that deliver real P&L impact. You'll be a trusted partner to Operations, Engineering, and Finance leadership, shaping how HelloFresh invests in and runs its production network. The role reports to the Director Indirect Procurement.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

- Design and execute category strategies: spend analysis, market intelligence, supplier landscape assessments, and sourcing roadmaps
- Lead complex RFx events and negotiate high-value contracts delivering TCO savings,not just unit price reductions
- Build and manage preferred supplier portfolio per category: qualification, KPIs, and continuous improvement
- Partner with senior stakeholders in Operations, Engineering, and Finance across multiple European markets
- Translate business needs into procurement strategies proactively.
- Drive governance and best-practice adoption: contract management, supplier risk, and compliance
- Present category strategies and sourcing outcomes clearly to Director and VP-level audiences
- Support broader Procurement Ops team, if necessary, in CapEx, MHE, etc. projects.

What you’ll bring

- 5+ years in indirect or operations procurement, with genuine category depth, not surface-level exposure
- Multi-category experience in an operations or manufacturing environment (FM, MRO,, Utilities, etc.); the broader and deeper, the stronger the profile
- Proven strategic sourcing skills: RFx design, complex negotiation, and contract structuring for technically complex purchases
- Track record of influencing and building trust with senior, cross-functional stakeholders across European markets
- Fluent in English; German and/or French language skills are a plus
- Strong analytical mindset:spend data, cost modelling, benchmarking, and business case development
- Able to travel to production sites across Europe, if required.

Please submit your resume in English.

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

- Initially we offer 2 years contract.
- Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
- Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
- Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
- Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
- Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!
